title: Optional Google Drive backup
ui: Drive account selection; scope; upload progress; restore policy

title: Authorized file access
hero: Choose files visibly on child device
ui: Supported SAF picker; local consent; selected file list
rule: No blanket remote browsing or covert extraction; OS/Play rules apply
error: Picker canceled; file moved; access revoked
accept: Only user-selected authorized files can be transferred.

title: Photo/video capability request
hero: Camera request is conditional, not secret
ui: Explain device/version; pending remote request; visible child action

accept: Never show successful capture unless child actually produces authorized result.
